data.name: Muzna
data.gender_notes: Muzna is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from 'Mizan', it signifies balance and justice in Islam. The name Muzna carries the meaning “Raindrop” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muzna usually hope their child will grow to embody raindrop and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Muzna is derived from 'Mizan', which is a Quranic term meaning balance and justice.
data.etymology: Muzna belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Raindrop.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muzna total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: مُزنہ
in_arabic.meaning: مُزنہ تعني الغيم أو السحاب الذي يحمل المطر
in_arabic.long_meaning: مُزنہ اسم علم مؤنث في اللغة العربية، مشتق من كلمة 'مزن' والتي تعني الغيم أو السحاب الذي يحمل المطر. وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفرقان الآية 2، حيث يقول الله تعالى: 'وَهُوَ الَذِي أَرْسَلَ السَحَابَ مُزنًا فَأَنشَأَ بِهِ سحابًا وَأَنزَلَ بِهِ مَاءً فَأَخْرَجَ بِهِ ثَمَرَاتٍ وَأَنشَأَ الْجِبَالَ وَالْحِجَارَةَ'

in_urdu.name: موزنا
in_urdu.meaning: موزنا کا مطلب ہے بارش کا بادل یا مینہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: موزنا ایک علم اسم ہے جو اردو زبان میں استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے بارش کا بادل یا مینہ۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے جہاں اس کا مطلب ہے غیم یا سحاب جو مینہ لاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुज़ना
in_hindi.meaning: मुज़ना का अर्थ है बारिश का बादल या मेघ
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुज़ना एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है जो हिंदी और उर्दू में प्रचलित है। इसका अर्थ है बारिश का बादल या मेघ। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जहां इसका अर्थ है घन या सحاب जो बारिश लाता है।

in_pashto.name: موزنه
in_pashto.meaning: موزنه د باران وریځ یا مینې معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: موزنه په پښتو ژبه کې یو ښکلی نوم دی چې د باران وریځ یا مینې معنی لري. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی چیرې چې د هغې معنی ده غن یا سحاب چې باران راوړي.

in_english.name: Muzna
in_english.meaning: Cloud that brings rain or shower
in_english.long_meaning: Muzna is a beautiful and meaningful name derived from Arabic roots. It refers to a cloud that brings rain or shower. In Islamic tradition, this name has a significant place as it is mentioned in the Quran. Muzna symbolizes blessings, mercy, and fertility.

The scales symbolize justice, fairness, and the equal distribution of rights and responsibilities in society. This name reminds us of the importance of maintaining equitability and harmony in everyday life.
data.spiritual_significance: In the mystical and philosophical sense, Muzna represents the attainment of balance and inner peace in an individual's spiritual journey.
